name: Gu 2017 BAY 1093884/befovacimab TFPI QSS-TMDD scenarios
description: Paper-fixed IV QSS-TMDD scenarios plus separately labelled exploratory SC and human endpoint calibrations.

scenarios.name: Exact Table II/III/Fig. 7 anchor
scenarios.description: Exact replay of Tables I-III, Figure 7 parameters/CVs, Figure 3 IC50s, narrative anchors, license/source status, and human endpoint statements.

scenarios.name: Paper-fixed cynomolgus IV 5 mg/kg QSS-TMDD
scenarios.description: Paper-fixed Figure 7 IV parameterization with complete Figure 2/4/5/6/7 overlays. No exploratory parameter overrides.

scenarios.name: Paper-fixed cynomolgus IV 20 mg/kg QSS-TMDD
scenarios.description: Paper-fixed Figure 7 IV parameterization with Figure 2/4/7 overlays. No exploratory parameter overrides.

scenarios.name: Human 0.4 mg/kg source-limited paper-structure probe
scenarios.description: Diagnostic transfer of the cynomolgus fixed effects to the reported human dose. The paper's human scaled values were not reported, so mismatch is expected and informative.

scenarios.name: Exploratory calibrated cynomolgus SC 5 mg/kg
scenarios.description: Aggregate dual-path SC absorption extension constrained jointly by Figure 2 PK, Figures 4-6 early/late PD, and Table II Cmax/Tmax/AUC. Separate from the paper-fixed IV model.

scenarios.name: Exploratory calibrated human 0.4 mg/kg endpoints
scenarios.description: Effective endpoint-matched human scenario reproducing reported Cmax, AUC0-168, and central-concentration inhibition at 24 h. It does not recover the omitted paper human scaling parameters.
